study.authority: User request 40cf4c15-2260-48ef-b3a1-7154d0d47554: task-conditioned exploratory collection and reliability-first fits
study.corpus_missing_evidence_rule: Omit first factual group of each split from retrieval index; keep independent labels and trusted reference
study.label_scope: Population/area/currency are source-snapshot facts, not claims of current census values; equivalence is constructed predicate-frame preservation, not truth verification
study.prior_overlap: Exclude all previous capital-study ISO groups. Public source files previously inspected, so reserved facts are not independently blinded unseen knowledge. Arithmetic uses distinct 3-digit operands; semantic frames are new.
study.final_custody: Procedural; final candidates prepared once, no later payload access
